# Reference configs

Real cards (the author's) that the schema, compat and studio tests validate and round-trip:
`tests/schema.test.js` (every config validates clean), `tests/compat.test.js` (renders the same
with the last release and this build) and `tests/studio.test.js` (studio round trip). Browser IDs
are replaced with placeholders; everything else is as the cards are used.
